review_description: Initial quote was easy .. CJ got back to me quickly and came out to premises to see what i needed.. noone else including those that solar quotes recommended did this.... Quote was reasonable considering the system i was getting and payment was not required until the system was installed.Installation was delayed slightly but ran smoothly. The electrician knew what he was doing .. They were punctual , tidy  polite and explained things well. Only a very slight issue on accent and understanding each other but all goodThe only other small issue  was around customer service and i only slightly marked them down on this .. I had questions after the installation  but initially was not getting any real answers or that made sense to me being new to this.They were minor issues around the process of what happened after  installation and around the solar edge app.I did eventually get answers and now the system and the app seems to be working as expectedHappy to recommend them
I understood Abscus was one of the installers listed in solar quotes which made me confident. Abacus team during the quoting process was very good and they  gave me the best value for money.

very detailed quote. had a few questions which were answered promptly. installation team arrived on time and cleaned up well after completion. they did all the grid connection communication and followed up that i was happy with the system. overall very smooth setup.

The quote was sent to me within 30mins.  Price is fair and terms and conditions are clear.The team came in to do the installation at 8am and finished at about 3pm.  Workers were polite.  They took off shoes when the went to the washroom.  They put everything in the bin before leaving.Customer service is good.  They organized the grid connection and help me install the app on my phone.
Recently i bought 30Kw system and i am so happy with their friendly customer support service .

We did a research before buying a solar system for our house and finally got a very good price from Abacussolar and we were very happy, 16 Jinko panels and SMA sunnyboy inverter was great as we got it under $6,000, and the other installers were quoted $2,000 more than what we got. This was a wonderful deal and the installers were also very helpful.
